description: Update source code of an existing ABAP behavior implementation class. Updates the implementations include. Manages lock, update, unlock, and optional activation.

activate.description: Activate behavior implementation after update. Default: true.

behavior_definition.description: Referenced Behavior Definition name. Accepted for compatibility; not forwarded to the write — the shipped update() no longer reads it (it writes the implementations include only, never the FOR BEHAVIOR OF main source).

class_name.description: Behavior Implementation class name. Must exist in the system.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

implementation_code.description: Implementation code for the implementations include. Contains the actual behavior implementation methods.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Optional if object is local or already in transport.

name: UpdateBehaviorImplementation
